shared: Changelings wear another unit's text and tribe on top of their own, borrowing from shop and board.
differ: What pays off: letting a disguise ride, putting on new ones, or swapping units with the shop.

takes.label: Let it ride
takes.line: Each disguise counts up Worn every turn; you let it ride for the Hundred-Year Nurse or Unmask to cash it in.
takes.look_if: a slow build-up you cash in with one big Unmask.

takes.label: The shop wardrobe
takes.line: Drag a shop unit onto a Changeling to wear it, leaving a 1-gold Stock; Nursemaid and Bettie pay every wear.
takes.look_if: to re-dress your board from every shop, growing wide and steady.

takes.label: Trading with the shop
takes.line: Exchange swaps your units into the shop for better ones, carrying buffs and Guises across; Penny Second steals enemy text in fights.
takes.look_if: to trade units with the shop and steal from opponents.
